//: Every word the walk's strip shows. {name} is filled by the runner. Direction is set in the walk's config, not here.
modeWaiting: Step by step — waiting for Next
changeOfPerson: Change of user: sign out and sign in as {name}
changeCaptionSwitch: {leaving} signs out, and {name} signs in on the sign-in screen.
changeCaptionFirst: {name} signs in on the sign-in screen.
chooseStartCaption: The steps before the one you choose run by themselves, without waiting for Next — they bring the app to the state that step needs.
noEarlierPlace: No earlier place in this walk
otherPersonsPlace: Cannot go there — it may be under another user
herePage: Here: the page the walk stopped on
stepAgain: Return here: {label} is inside something opened — the step runs again from its start
insideOpened: (inside something opened — showing its page and section)
